records.question: For each state, return state and total delivered order amount, including states with no delivered orders as zero. Sort by state.
records.reference_sql: SELECT c.state,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='delivered' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END),0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.state ORDER BY c.state

FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.state
ORDER BY c.state
LIMIT 50;

records.question: Which orders tie for the largest amount? Return only order IDs, ascending.

records.question: What percentage of orders are delivered? Return one number from 0 to 100 without rounding.

records.question: For each customer, return customer ID and the number of delivered orders, including zero counts. Sort by customer ID.

records.question: Return only IDs of customers who have at least two delivered orders, ascending.

FROM customers
JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE orders.status = 'delivered'

records.question: Calculate total item value as quantity times unit price for delivered orders only. Return one total.
records.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='delivered'

records.question: Return order ID and total quantity for delivered orders with at least three units. Sort by order ID.
records.reference_sql: SELECT o.id,SUM(i.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='delivered' GROUP BY o.id HAVING SUM(i.quantity)>=3 ORDER BY o.id
records.generated_sql:
SELECT orders.id AS order_id, SUM(order_items.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
WHERE orders.status = 'delivered'

records.question: Draw a line chart of cumulative monthly order amount over all statuses. Use YYYY-MM and a running total of monthly sums, chronological order, only months with orders.
